props.name: schema
props.description: The schema to render. The root is usually an object.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Starting value when uncontrolled. Defaults are built from the schema.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the whole value after every edit.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called with the value once it passes every rule in the schema.
